title: Biocatalytic Radical C(sp3)–N Coupling via Active Site Templating
evidence_summary: Summary Paragraph Stereoselective nucleophilic substitution to access α-tertiary amines relies on copper-catalyzed radical approaches in which the substitution is mediated by metal–anilide coordination.1 These systems, however, are constrained by competing arene radical alkylation pathways.2 Here we report a distinct photoenzymatic mechanism for enantioconvergent nucleophilic substitution that operates without metal coordination to the nucleophile.
